Accessibility Statement

We want everyone to be able to use this website. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 level AA.

What we do

  • Semantic headings and landmarks, a skip link, and keyboard-operable menus and forms.
  • Text alternatives for images and visible focus states.
  • Respect for reduced-motion preferences.

Feedback

If you run into a barrier, email admin@adu-america.com or call (720) 544-1352. We will respond and work to fix the problem. We can also share information in another format.
